description: HashiCorp Vault Policy Audit — Offline audit of a HashiCorp Vault ACL policy (HCL or JSON): policy= (required). Flags root wildcards, sudo, dangerous sys/ paths (raw, seal, rekey, generate-root), writable sys/policy, sys/auth, sys/mounts and sys/audit, token minting, auth role and identity writes, PKI root signing, transit key export, mount-wide wildcards, deprecated policy= shorthand and duplicate paths. Returns each path's capabilities, findings with fixes, score, grade and PASS/REVIEW/FAIL. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_vault_policy_check
